Every minute, every day

Los Alamos National Laboratory brings together weapons expertise, scientific research, technical innovation and operational strengths to advance deterrence and help secure the nation.

The Lab

Remember: Lab is a No-Drone Zone

Mission-Focused Science, Technology, Engineering

Los Alamos maps the changing sounds of the Arctic to strengthen global monitoring

Community

Brothers on a mission: Los Alamos lineage dates back to 1800s

Community

Bradbury Science Museum expands High-Tech Halloween event

What we do

Los Alamos National Laboratory addresses national security challenges by advancing breakthroughs in science and technology. We work alongside the Department of Energy to support energy advancements and environmental management.
Learn about our missionarrow_forward

Explore our science in action

Los Alamos scientists named American Physical Society Fellows

Guo, Lin recognized for physics excellence.

Quantum Summer School brings students together in new Center for Quantum Computing

Participants tackle cutting-edge research, learn from quantum experts.

Dynamic imaging at Los Alamos: Look inside extreme physics

Techniques like proton radiography let scientists to see deep inside experiments in fractions of a second.

Lab launches frontier AI models on Venado supercomputer

Supercomputer running latest OpenAI reasoning models on NVIDIA Grace Hopper GPUs to accelerate national security-related science.

URSA is an AI agent transforming how science gets done

Framework is built to bring AI into the heart of scientific discovery.
